# WordCloudElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasWordCloudElement` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasWordCloudDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasWordCloudDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasWordCloudDiagram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Words sized by frequency, optionally inside a shape or image mask

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasWordCloudExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasWordCloudExamples.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasWordCloudElement> CreateWordCloud( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasWordCloudElement> CreateWordCloudWithWords( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, const std::vector<WordCloudWord>& words, const std::string& title = "");
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasWordCloudElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `SetOnWordClick()` | `void SetOnWordClick(std::function<void(const WordCloudPlacedWord&)> callback)` | Takes a callback. |
| `SetOnWordHover()` | `void SetOnWordHover(std::function<void(const WordCloudPlacedWord&)> callback)` | Takes a callback. |
| `SetOnLayoutComplete()` | `void SetOnLayoutComplete(std::function<void(size_t, size_t)> callback)` | Takes a callback. |
| `SetWordTooltipGenerator()` | `void SetWordTooltipGenerator(std::function<std::string(const WordCloudPlacedWord&)> generator)` | Takes a callback. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md): `SetCustomTooltipGenerator`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### struct `WordCloudWord`

One input word. Only `text` and `weight` are required; everything else is an optional per-word override of the cloud-wide settings (the pattern used by WordArt.com and ECharts per-datum styling).

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `std::string text` |  |
| `weight` | `double weight = 1.0` |  |
| `color` | `Color color = Colors::Transparent` | Per-word style overrides. Transparent color / NaN rotation = "use the cloud-wide color mode / rotation mode for this word". |
| `rotationDeg` | `float rotationDeg = std::numeric_limits<float>::quiet_NaN()` |  |
| `fontFamily` | `std::string fontFamily` | empty = cloud font |
| `fontWeight` | `FontWeight fontWeight = FontWeight::Normal` |  |
| `hasFontWeight` | `bool hasFontWeight = false` |  |
| `tooltip` | `std::string tooltip` | extra tooltip line |
| `userTag` | `std::string userTag` | free-form tag (URL, id...) passed to callbacks |

Methods: `HasExplicitColor`, `HasExplicitRotation`

### enum `WordCloudShape`

Region the words are constrained to (wordcloud2.js `shape`). When a mask image is set it always wins over the geometric shape.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Rectangle` | whole plot area (d3-cloud default) |
| `Ellipse` | ellipse filling the plot area |
| `Circle` | largest centered circle |
| `Cardioid` | heart-like curve |
| `Diamond` |  |
| `Square` | centered square |
| `Triangle` | upright triangle |
| `TriangleForward` | right-pointing triangle |
| `Pentagon` |  |
| `Star` |  |

### enum `WordCloudSpiral`

Search path used when looking for a free spot (d3-cloud `spiral`).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Archimedean` | round spiral, organic look (default everywhere) |
| `Rectangular` | rectangular spiral, tighter packing in corners |

### enum `WordCloudScaling`

weight -> font size mapping (Highcharts weight, Kumo FontScalar, Python relative_scaling family).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Linear` | size ∝ weight |
| `SquareRoot` | size ∝ sqrt(weight) (default; tames outliers) |
| `Logarithmic` | size ∝ log(1 + weight) |
| `Rank` | size from rank order only, ignores magnitudes |

### enum `WordCloudRotationMode`

How rotation angles are chosen (wordcloud2.js minRotation/maxRotation/ rotationSteps, Highcharts rotation.orientations, Python prefer_horizontal).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoRotation` | all words horizontal |
| `Steps` | discrete angles: `rotationSteps` values in \[min,max\] |
| `RandomRange` | uniform random angle in \[min,max\] |
| `PerWordOnly` | only words with an explicit rotationDeg are rotated |

### enum `WordCloudColorMode`

Word coloring strategy.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Palette` | cycle through the palette in placement order |
| `RandomFromPalette` | random palette entry per word (seeded) |
| `ByWeightGradient` | interpolate gradientLowColor..gradientHighColor by weight |
| `SingleColor` | every word in defaultWordColor |
| `FromImage` | sample color under the word from the color/mask image |

### enum `WordCloudCenterBlock`

Which area the center image blocks out of the layout.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `BoundingBox` | full image rectangle + padding |
| `Ellipse` | inscribed ellipse + padding (words hug a round logo) |
| `AlphaPixels` | only opaque pixels + padding (words flow into |

### struct `WordCloudCenterImage`

Optional image drawn in the middle of the cloud. The covered region is removed from the layout grid so words flow around the image.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `imagePath` | `std::string imagePath` | file path (loaded via UCImageRaster) |
| `sizeRatio` | `float sizeRatio = 0.30f` | Size: fraction of min(plotWidth, plotHeight); explicit pixel size wins when non-zero. Aspect ratio of the source image is always preserved. |
| `pixelWidth` | `int pixelWidth = 0` |  |
| `pixelHeight` | `int pixelHeight = 0` |  |
| `offset` | `Point2Dd offset` | shift from the cloud center, px |
| `padding` | `float padding = 10.0f` | free space kept around the image |
| `blockMode` | `WordCloudCenterBlock blockMode = WordCloudCenterBlock::BoundingBox` |  |
| `opacity` | `float opacity = 1.0f` | 0..1 |
| `clipToCircle` | `bool clipToCircle = false` | round avatar-style crop |
| `cornerRadius` | `float cornerRadius = 0.0f` | rounded-rect crop when &gt; 0 |
| `drawBorder` | `bool drawBorder = false` |  |
| `borderColor` | `Color borderColor = Colors::White` |  |
| `borderWidth` | `float borderWidth = 3.0f` |  |

Methods: `IsValid`

### struct `WordCloudTextOptions`

Options for SetWordsFromText() - building the cloud from raw prose the way the Python wordcloud package does (stopwords, collocations, normalization).

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `maxWords` | `int maxWords = 100` | keep the N most frequent words |
| `minWordLength` | `int minWordLength = 2` | drop shorter tokens |
| `minFrequency` | `int minFrequency = 1` | drop rarer tokens |
| `toLowercase` | `bool toLowercase = true` | case-fold before counting |
| `includeNumbers` | `bool includeNumbers = false` | keep pure-number tokens |
| `useDefaultStopwords` | `bool useDefaultStopwords = true` | built-in English stopword list |
| `extraStopwords` | `std::unordered_set<std::string> extraStopwords` | user additions |
| `detectBigrams` | `bool detectBigrams = false` | count frequent word pairs as one |
| `minBigramCount` | `int minBigramCount = 3` | entry ("new york") - collocations pair must occur this often |
